The cleaver features a large, rectangular stainless steel blade with a visible brand logo ('Huang') etched near the spine. The handle is black, likely plastic or composite, attached to the tang with visible rivets. The lighting creates a metallic sheen on the blade surface.

artifact_observations.reasoning: There is text/logo on the blade. While it resembles a brand name ('Huang' or similar), the characters are slightly soft and lack the crisp, laser-etched precision often seen in real product photography. It is legible but has a slight 'AI-generated text' smoothness.

The gradient of light on the metal blade is very smooth, almost airbrushed. Real steel usually has finer micro-scratches or more complex specular highlights. This suggests a slight digital smoothing artifact common in AI generation.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific type of knife and rule out misclassification as a chef's knife or santoku.
To analyze the legibility and structural integrity of the text on the blade, checking for character fusion or nonsensical glyphs.
To detect subtle texture inconsistencies in the metal reflection and handle material that might indicate generative artifacts.
To ensure the rivets and tang connection are physically logical and not fused or floating.

focus_areas: Text legibility and structure on the blade
Physical plausibility of rivet placement and handle attachment
Realism of metallic reflections and surface texture
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the text on the blade. AI models often struggle with small, curved text on reflective surfaces. Check if the letters are distinct or if they melt into each other. Also, verify the rivets; they should appear as distinct 3D objects casting tiny shadows, not just flat circles painted on the handle.
